scripts.db:start: cd packages/db && DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock npx supabase start
scripts.db:stop: cd packages/db && DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock npx supabase stop
scripts.db:types: cd packages/db && DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock npx supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > src/types.ts
